items.text: ETR Sunday injury dump: QUESTIONABLE Lamar Jackson, Puka Nacua, Breece Hall, Baker Mayfield, Rico Dowdle and others; OUT Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson; IN Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson.
items.why: Official ETR compilation of latest practice/game statuses ahead of Week 7.
items.implication: Major role shifts and start/sit pivots across multiple teams; monitor Qs for pregame.
items.opportunity: Snap/route/target vacuums for teammates of OUTs; full roles for INs.

items.text: 49ers coach confirms Mike Evans OUT (Achilles); Schefter/ETR also Deebo Samuel OUT. Levitan: Kittle will go nuts due to scheme + entire WR corps hurt; tempted by CMC more slot with Kaelon Black and WR injuries (despite usual skepticism of RB-as-WR).
items.why: Coach confirm Evans; multi-source Deebo; Levitan opportunity analysis on funnel to Kittle/CMC.
items.implication: Heavy TE/RB target and slot usage spike; start Kittle confidently, CMC elevated.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets/red-zone; CMC slot snaps and receiving work.

items.text: Ravens list Lamar Jackson questionable (ankle) vs Bengals. Jackson: 'headed in the right direction.' ETR and Levitan flag as crucial Q for slate.
items.why: Official listing after return to practice; self-report positive.
items.implication: Game-time or early Sunday decision; Ravens offense heavily impacted if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated rush/pass for backups and weapons like Flowers/Henry/Andrews.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy is Tyler Higbee #1 then Konata Mumpfield, Colby Parkinson, Tutu Atwell etc. McVay: felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame; majority of Thursday practice.
items.why: Calf limited explosion; McVay comments + Levitan target hierarchy if out. Berry notes prior Puka-out TE share hit 37%.
items.implication: Monitor closely; Higbee/Parkinson spike if OUT; Puka risky if limited.
items.opportunity: TE heavy usage and remaining WR routes if inactive.

items.text: Rashee Rice, Davante Adams, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Jeremiyah Love all OUT per ETR/Schefter. Adams multi-week hamstring.
items.why: ETR dump + Schefter official list confirmation.
items.implication: Clear sits; look to handcuffs and remaining pass-catchers (Worthy etc for Rice; Colts TE alternatives; Texans RBs; etc).
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for backups and complementary pieces.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected back Week 7 vs Cowboys (MNF). Berry and Stephania: if out there, right back in fantasy lineups. Efficient in prior full games; Dallas soft vs RBs.
items.why: Practice return and reports; Berry start confidence + matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB if confirmed; monitor for any snap limit.
items.opportunity: Feature back carries/targets vs weak Cowboys run D.

items.text: Breece Hall questionable (quad). Stephania Bell cautious on immediate return, but Berry starts him if active vs Miami.
items.why: ETR/Schefter Q listing; Berry willingness to start if plays in soft matchup.
items.implication: Start if confirmed active; sit/handcuff if limited or OUT.
items.opportunity: Full RB1 role vs Dolphins if healthy enough.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers D inflating opposing RB production (DvP +4.4%, recent big games to White/Holani/Harvey/Love). Sweet setup for full-workload Bijan Robinson.
items.why: Official OUT + Levitan DvP data and recent RB receiving/rush production allowed by SF.
items.implication: Strong Bijan upgrade/start with no BRob and favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, targets, red-zone for Bijan; full backfield.

items.text: Cole Kmet to IR, season-ending knee (coach Ben Johnson confirm). Levitan: Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-TE sets giving Burden more juice. Berry: Loveland 30% TS / 19.2 PPR PPG / 6+ rec both games since Caleb return.
items.why: Official IR; Levitan route/YPRR data + set reduction; Berry usage stats with Williams.
items.implication: Immediate upgrades for Burden and Loveland in Bears passing game.
items.opportunity: Higher route % and targets for Burden; sustained high TS for Loveland.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN. Allowed facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football). Backups MarShawn Lloyd and Kaleb Johnson poor EPA/rush (49th/53rd). Long-term outlook discussed on ROS show.
items.why: Facility access details + backup inefficiency data; ETR lists IN.
items.implication: Likely lead role if cleared; monitor snaps after absence. Berry fades due to layoff.
items.opportunity: Primary carries if volume returns; weak handcuffs.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on workload questions post-layoff vs Levitan positive notes.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks. Clear downgrade in role/opportunity.
items.why: Direct snap share data over multi-week sample.
items.implication: Sit or lower expectations; not a reliable RB2/flex currently.
items.opportunity: Low snap/route share limits ceiling regardless of talent.

items.text: Berry Loves: A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% TS buy even after drops), DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft, Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving, Matthew Golden. Hates: Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Travis Kelce, Josh Jacobs (workload post-layoff).
items.why: Usage (AJB routes/TS), matchups (Lions soft pass, friendly RB spots), volume consistency. Hates on tough matchups/role concerns.
items.implication: Prioritize Loves in lineups; fade Hates this week.
items.opportunity: High route/target shares and favorable DvP for Loves.
items.conflict: Berry HATE Jacobs while ETR/Levitan note facility access and IN status with weak backups.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: AJ Brown 97% routes / 33% TS (buy despite drops/yards); prior Puka-out Rams TE target share 37% (Higbee preferred short-term with Adams out long-term); other usage on Stroud, Nix ADOT, Jeanty inefficiency, etc.
items.why: Concrete route/target/share and historical TE usage numbers.
items.implication: Strong buy on AJB volume; TE streaming lean if Puka limited/out.
items.opportunity: Sustained high routes/TS for AJB; TE funnel on Rams.
